samples.visual: Island map screen with grid, circular zone and red zone visible; streamer camera appears at upper right. This is consistent with a PUBG map view, not a combat scene.
Large streamer camera view, dark left area and programme/chat presentation with danmaku; no game image visible at this sampled point.

assessment: The title-described programme/pre-chat P1 is mixed at the sampled points: t≈2000 displays an island map with circle/red-zone markings and streamer camera, while t≈2600 shows programme/chat presentation without a game image. This supports review of a PUBG content association for the P1 portion, despite the entry's current empty games field, but the map view alone does not establish active gameplay, a complete PUBG segment, game version, or overall entry scope. The programme remains a valid content aspect and is not a reason to remove the whole source.
limitations: Only two static player sample points in P1 were examined; P2 was not played.
No audio was listened to; no exact start/end boundary, duration of a game segment, continuity, or completeness was established.
The map screen is consistent with PUBG but does not independently authenticate game identity or active play.
No old segments were used to calculate seeks or duration; no formal data, source table, or master observation was changed.
